verdict.rationale: Linear's rate-limiting docs publish exact per-auth API limits, leaky-bucket refill, complexity limits and X-RateLimit headers, so API overage clearly means throttling rather than charges. Admins can also set workspace-wide and per-user spend limits that reset periodically, but the evidence does not say what happens when an agent or Loop hits those limits. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the response on exceeding API limits (error code, retry behavior), and what happens on exceeding automation/agent/Loop usage or spend limits (overage charges, throttling, or hard stop).
